question: In which of the following states is the Srivilliputhur Elephant Reserve located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Srivilliputhur Elephant Reserve is located in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It is** the fifth Tiger Reserve of Tamil Nadu** and the 51st tiger reserve of India.&l
